label.translation: This section controls optional functionality with the Electronics workspace.

label.devLabel:
Design reliable products with the Signal Integrity Extension
Manage PCB design electromagnetic performance by controlling the impedance of every critical transmission line.
Autodesk® Fusion® Signal Integrity Extension, powered by Ansys, enables designers to analyze PCB design electromagnetic performance, mitigate impedance mismatches and coupled geometries issues, to improve design performance and compliance, speed up development cycle, and lower physical testing costs.
label.translation:
Design reliable products with the Signal Integrity Extension
Manage PCB design electromagnetic performance by controlling the impedance of every critical transmission line.
Autodesk® Fusion® Signal Integrity Extension, powered by Ansys, enables designers to analyze PCB design electromagnetic performance, mitigate impedance mismatches and coupled geometries issues, to improve design performance and compliance, speed up development cycle, and lower physical testing costs.

label.devLabel: Exports PCB data to Ansys Electronics Desktop.
label.translation: Exports PCB data to Ansys Electronics Desktop.

label.devLabel: Specify the exported file location and the file type. Hand the file off to the Ansys Electronics Desktop.
label.translation: Specify the exported file location and the file type. Hand the file off to the Ansys Electronics Desktop.

label.devLabel: Attaches a 3D model from your Hub or a local STEP file to the footprint.
label.translation: Attaches a 3D model from your Hub or a local STEP file to the footprint.

label.devLabel: Creates a new package from the selected geometry.
label.translation: Creates a new package from the selected geometry.

label.devLabel: Generate Gerber, NC Drill, Assembly and Drawing outputs and save the ZIP output file in current directory.
label.translation: Generate Gerber, NC Drill, Assembly and Drawing outputs and save the ZIP output file in current directory.

label.devLabel: The outputs generation will use the best matching CAMJOB template based on the design's number of signal (copper) layers.
label.translation: The outputs generation will use the best matching CAMJOB template based on the design's number of signal (copper) layers.

label.devLabel: Generate ODB++ output and save it to the specified compressed output file (default = ZIP).
label.translation: Generate ODB++ output and save it to the specified compressed output file (default = ZIP).

label.devLabel: The ODB++ output generation will use any valid CAMJOB file that includes ODB++ output configuration and resides in the ODB++ output directory. If there is no such CAMJOB file in the output directory the best matching CAMJOB template based on the design's number of copper layers will be used instead.
label.translation: The ODB++ output generation will use any valid CAMJOB file that includes ODB++ output configuration and resides in the ODB++ output directory. If there is no such CAMJOB file in the output directory the best matching CAMJOB template based on the design's number of copper layers will be used instead.

label.devLabel: Executes a User Language Program from the library.
label.translation: Executes a User Language Program from the library.

label.devLabel: The Run command starts the User Language Program from the file 'file_name'.
label.translation: The Run command starts the User Language Program from the file 'file_name'.

label.devLabel: Assigns a custom 3D model to a part or element in a schematic or board.
label.translation: Assigns a custom 3D model to a part or element in a schematic or board.

label.devLabel: Existing references to a 3D model are replaced by the new package.
label.translation: Existing references to a 3D model are replaced by the new package.

label.devLabel: Adds a non-plated hole to the 2D PCB.
label.translation: Adds a non-plated hole to the 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Specify the drill parameter, indicating the hole diameter, then click to place a hole at a grid point.
label.translation: Specify the drill parameter, indicating the hole diameter, then click to place a hole at a grid point.

label.devLabel: Adds a symbol to a component.
label.translation: Adds a symbol to a component.

label.devLabel: This command fetches a symbol to insert into the component.
label.translation: This command fetches a symbol to insert into the component.

label.devLabel: When entering several texts it is not necessary to invoke the command each time, as the text command remains active after placing text with the mouse.
label.translation: When entering several texts it is not necessary to invoke the command each time, as the text command remains active after placing text with the mouse.

label.devLabel: You can align objects in relation to one another or move their origin to a nearby grid point.
label.translation: You can align objects in relation to one another or move their origin to a nearby grid point.

label.devLabel: Calculates signal integrity for a selected signal. Returns impedance, propagation delay and other values for each segment of the signal path in tabular and graphical form.
label.translation: Calculates signal integrity for a selected signal. Returns impedance, propagation delay and other values for each segment of the signal path in tabular and graphical form.

label.devLabel: Define the frequency and target impedance range to flag and identify impedance issues to resolve in the circuit design.
label.translation: Define the frequency and target impedance range to flag and identify impedance issues to resolve in the circuit design.

label.devLabel: Draw an arc of variable diameter, width, and length.
label.translation: Draw an arc of variable diameter, width, and length.

label.devLabel: The first click defines a point on a circle, the second its diameter. Right-click to change the direction from first to second point.
label.translation: The first click defines a point on a circle, the second its diameter. Right-click to change the direction from first to second point.

label.devLabel: Positions selected objects in a linear or circular formation.
label.translation: Positions selected objects in a linear or circular formation.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to arrange. Specify the formation type, the X and Y spacing for rectangular or angular spacing for circular, and the start point. Click OK.
label.translation: Select the objects to arrange. Specify the formation type, the X and Y spacing for rectangular or angular spacing for circular, and the start point. Click OK.

label.devLabel: Definition of part attributes and their display.
label.translation: Definition of part attributes and their display.

label.devLabel: An attribute is a combination of a name and a value that can specify any kind of information for a given part.
label.translation: An attribute is a combination of a name and a value that can specify any kind of information for a given part.

label.devLabel: If signal names are specified or signals are selected with the mouse, only these signals are routed. Without parameters the command will try to route all signals. The command has support for general rules and custom rules with net class scopes.
label.translation: If signal names are specified or signals are selected with the mouse, only these signals are routed. Without parameters the command will try to route all signals. The command has support for general rules and custom rules with net class scopes.

label.devLabel: Show or hide component origin markers on the bottom layer.
label.translation: Show or hide component origin markers on the bottom layer.

label.devLabel: Draws buses on the bus layer of a schematic.
label.translation: Draws buses on the bus layer of a schematic.

label.devLabel: A Bus is a collection of nets. A Bus has a specification and is drawn as one or more bus line segments. The bus specification can include a unique alias, which is a short name used to identify the bus.
label.translation: A Bus is a collection of nets. A Bus has a specification and is drawn as one or more bus line segments. The bus specification can include a unique alias, which is a short name used to identify the bus.

label.devLabel: Breaks out a single, selected, or all nets as new wires extending from a bus.
label.translation: Breaks out a single, selected, or all nets as new wires extending from a bus.

label.devLabel: Automatically add wires with net labels extending from a bus, saving time, and reducing errors.
label.translation: Automatically add wires with net labels extending from a bus, saving time, and reducing errors.

label.devLabel: The Change command is used to change or preset object properties. Select the desired parameter and value from the Change menu, or enter it from the keyboard.
label.translation: The Change command is used to change or preset object properties. Select the desired parameter and value from the Change menu, or enter it from the keyboard.

label.devLabel: Adds a circle to a drawing.
label.translation: Adds a circle to a drawing.

label.devLabel: The Line Width parameter defines the width of the circle's line and is the same parameter used in the Line command.
label.translation: The Line Width parameter defines the width of the circle's line and is the same parameter used in the Line command.

label.devLabel: Creates Net Classes and adds nets to them.
label.translation: Creates Net Classes and adds nets to them.

label.devLabel: Net Classes are used by Design Rules and the Design Manager for scoping and organization of signals.
label.translation: Net Classes are used by Design Rules and the Design Manager for scoping and organization of signals.

label.devLabel: Provides presets to help configure which objects display in the 3D PCB document and whether or not bitmap images are used to represent traces.
label.translation: Provides presets to help configure which objects display in the 3D PCB document and whether or not bitmap images are used to represent traces.

label.devLabel: Select the 2D PCB objects you want represented in the 3D PCB document. Components without a 3D model are identified so you can decide whether or not to exclude them. Included components without 3D models are represented by rectangular shapes.
label.translation: Select the 2D PCB objects you want represented in the 3D PCB document. Components without a 3D model are identified so you can decide whether or not to exclude them. Included components without 3D models are represented by rectangular shapes.

label.devLabel: Makes all hidden PCB sketches visible.
label.translation: Makes all hidden PCB sketches visible.

label.devLabel: Copies objects within the same drawing, or between libraries. The system generates a new name for the copy but retains the old value. When copying signals (wires), buses, and nets the names are retained, but in all other cases a new name is assigned.
label.translation: Copies objects within the same drawing, or between libraries. The system generates a new name for the copy but retains the old value. When copying signals (wires), buses, and nets the names are retained, but in all other cases a new name is assigned.

label.devLabel: Transfers selected properties of an object to other objects of the same type.
label.translation: Transfers selected properties of an object to other objects of the same type.

label.devLabel: Select the properties you want to transfer to other objects of the same type in the Select properties dialog of the selected object, then close the dialog with OK, and click the target objects.
label.translation: Select the properties you want to transfer to other objects of the same type in the Select properties dialog of the selected object, then close the dialog with OK, and click the target objects.

label.devLabel: Design rules are evaluated each time rules are checked. Can load design rule presets from external sources and scope design rules to defined parameters.
label.translation: Design rules are evaluated each time rules are checked. Can load design rule presets from external sources and scope design rules to defined parameters.

label.devLabel: Parts, pads, SMDs, pins and gates can also be selected by their name, which is especially useful if the object is outside the currently shown window area. Note that when selecting a multi-gate part in a schematic by name, you will need to enter the full instance name, consisting of part and gate name.
label.translation: Parts, pads, SMDs, pins and gates can also be selected by their name, which is especially useful if the object is outside the currently shown window area. Note that when selecting a multi-gate part in a schematic by name, you will need to enter the full instance name, consisting of part and gate name.

label.devLabel: Edits parameters that drive design geometry.
label.translation: Edits parameters that drive design geometry.

label.devLabel: Preferences include Layer Stack, Annular Ring, Pad/SMD Shapes, Thermal Isolation, and Masks. Adjusting these settings automatically calculates PCB geometries according to preferences.
label.translation: Preferences include Layer Stack, Annular Ring, Pad/SMD Shapes, Thermal Isolation, and Masks. Adjusting these settings automatically calculates PCB geometries according to preferences.

label.devLabel: If an object is first selected, a dimension is applied, such as the length of a straight wire, or diameter of a hole. If no object is selected, the current dimension type is added; right-click to cycle through the various types.
label.translation: If an object is first selected, a dimension is applied, such as the length of a straight wire, or diameter of a hole. If no object is selected, the current dimension type is added; right-click to cycle through the various types.

label.devLabel: Control the display of drawing layers, showing all, used layers, or unused layers.
label.translation: Control the display of drawing layers, showing all, used layers, or unused layers.

label.devLabel: Use the eye icon beside a layer to turn it on or off. Double-click a layer to review or modify its properties.
label.translation: Use the eye icon beside a layer to turn it on or off. Double-click a layer to review or modify its properties.

label.devLabel: Add, modify, or delete document-level attributes, such as author or project identification number. Use the Text command to place the attribute string in the canvas.
label.translation: Add, modify, or delete document-level attributes, such as author or project identification number. Use the Text command to place the attribute string in the canvas.

label.devLabel: Use this command to test schematics for electrical errors. If a board file is loaded, the ERC command also runs a consistency check between schematic and board.
label.translation: Use this command to test schematics for electrical errors. If a board file is loaded, the ERC command also runs a consistency check between schematic and board.

label.devLabel: Edits the 3D model associated with a part or element in a schematic or board.
label.translation: Edits the 3D model associated with a part or element in a schematic or board.

label.devLabel: When a custom 3D model is associated, edits the custom 3D model instead of the originally managed 3D model.
label.translation: When a custom 3D model is associated, edits the custom 3D model instead of the originally managed 3D model.

label.devLabel: Edits the primary sketch that defines the board outline.
label.translation: Edits the primary sketch that defines the board outline.

label.devLabel: Create a closed profile to define the board. You can project geometry from the assembly context to ensure the PCB outline stays updated with the mechanical assembly.
label.translation: Create a closed profile to define the board. You can project geometry from the assembly context to ensure the PCB outline stays updated with the mechanical assembly.

label.devLabel: Errors, if detected, are displayed in the Errors panel. Real-time rule checking can be enabled in the application settings for instant error detection.
label.translation: Errors, if detected, are displayed in the Errors panel. Real-time rule checking can be enabled in the application settings for instant error detection.

label.devLabel: Exports libraries to allow you to make individual changes to components in a project.
label.translation: Exports libraries to allow you to make individual changes to components in a project.

label.devLabel: Use to generate one or more libraries containing the selected components. Make your changes in the libraries and then use UPDATE to display the changes in the schematic or board.
label.translation: Use to generate one or more libraries containing the selected components. Make your changes in the libraries and then use UPDATE to display the changes in the schematic or board.

label.devLabel: Creates fanouts from devices and signals.
label.translation: Creates fanouts from devices and signals.

label.devLabel: The command creates a routed wire and attached via from pads of the selected device or signal. Only surface mount devices (SMD) or ball-grid array (BGA) devices are fanned out; devices with through-hole pads are ignored.
label.translation: The command creates a routed wire and attached via from pads of the selected device or signal. Only surface mount devices (SMD) or ball-grid array (BGA) devices are fanned out; devices with through-hole pads are ignored.

label.devLabel: Rotates components and objects along their X-axis and places them on the opposite side of a double-sided PCB.
label.translation: Rotates components and objects along their X-axis and places them on the opposite side of a double-sided PCB.

label.devLabel: Choose to reroute, disconnect, or unroute the electrical connections.
label.translation: Choose to reroute, disconnect, or unroute the electrical connections.

label.devLabel: The board is rotated 180 degrees around the Y axis, in model space, to look at the opposite side.
label.translation: The board is rotated 180 degrees around the Y axis, in model space, to look at the opposite side.

label.devLabel: Swaps equivalent gates on a schematic.
label.translation: Swaps equivalent gates on a schematic.

label.devLabel: Both gates must be identical with the same number of pins and the same Swaplevel in the device definition, but they need not be in the same device.
label.translation: Both gates must be identical with the same number of pins and the same Swaplevel in the device definition, but they need not be in the same device.

label.devLabel: Provides controls for defining the drawing grid.
label.translation: Provides controls for defining the drawing grid.

label.devLabel: Set grid display on/off, display style, and size.
label.translation: Set grid display on/off, display style, and size.

label.devLabel: Enable to synchronize selections across schematic and 2D PCB. Selecting an item in one view automatically selects the corresponding item in the other.
label.translation: Enable to synchronize selections across schematic and 2D PCB. Selecting an item in one view automatically selects the corresponding item in the other.

label.devLabel: Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.
label.translation: Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.

label.devLabel: Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.
label.translation: Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.

label.devLabel: Selects objects enclosed in a polygon selection area.
label.translation: Selects objects enclosed in a polygon selection area.

label.devLabel: A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.
label.translation: A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.

label.devLabel: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
label.translation: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

label.devLabel: Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.
label.translation: Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.

label.devLabel: Click and drag from upper-left to lower-right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from lower-right to upper-left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.
label.translation: Click and drag from upper-left to lower-right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from lower-right to upper-left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.

label.devLabel: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.
label.translation: Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

label.devLabel: Ignores design rules, allowing different copper objects to connect.
label.translation: Ignores design rules, allowing different copper objects to connect.

label.devLabel: An object's properties are displayed in a dialog, where they can be modified.
label.translation: An object's properties are displayed in a dialog, where they can be modified.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved 2D PCB in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved 2D PCB in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved design block (.dbl) in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved design block (.dbl) in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: If a schematic is associated with the inserted design block a new sheet containing the schematic is added. Switch to the Schematic to view the sheet.
label.translation: If a schematic is associated with the inserted design block a new sheet containing the schematic is added. Switch to the Schematic to view the sheet.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved design block (.dbl) in the canvas of the active Schematic.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved design block (.dbl) in the canvas of the active Schematic.

label.devLabel: If a 2D PCB is associated with the inserted design block the components are positioned at the bottom left of the PCB. Switch to the 2D PCB to reposition the components.
label.translation: If a 2D PCB is associated with the inserted design block the components are positioned at the bottom left of the PCB. Switch to the 2D PCB to reposition the components.

label.devLabel: Browse to and select a DXF or DWG file.
label.translation: Browse to and select a DXF or DWG file.

label.devLabel: Specify the desired insert values. To explicitly place the file, use Placement Origin. To implicitly place the file, click the location in the canvas.
label.translation: Specify the desired insert values. To explicitly place the file, use Placement Origin. To implicitly place the file, click the location in the canvas.

label.devLabel: Select the file, specify the insert values, and click in the canvas to place the file, then click Done.
label.translation: Select the file, specify the insert values, and click in the canvas to place the file, then click Done.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved project in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved project in the canvas of the active 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: If a schematic is associated with the inserted project a new sheet containing the schematic is added. Switch to the Schematic to view the sheet.
label.translation: If a schematic is associated with the inserted project a new sheet containing the schematic is added. Switch to the Schematic to view the sheet.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved project in the canvas of the active Schematic.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved project in the canvas of the active Schematic.

label.devLabel: If a 2D PCB is associated with the inserted project the components are positioned at the bottom left of the PCB. Switch to the 2D PCB to reposition the components.
label.translation: If a 2D PCB is associated with the inserted project the components are positioned at the bottom left of the PCB. Switch to the 2D PCB to reposition the components.

label.devLabel: Inserts a previously saved schematic in the canvas of the active Schematic.
label.translation: Inserts a previously saved schematic in the canvas of the active Schematic.

label.devLabel: Browse to and select an SVG file.
label.translation: Browse to and select an SVG file.

label.devLabel: Specify the desired insert values. To explicitly place the file, use Placement Origin. To implicitly place the file, click the location in the canvas.
label.translation: Specify the desired insert values. To explicitly place the file, use Placement Origin. To implicitly place the file, click the location in the canvas.

label.devLabel: Choose the Target Layer to place the vector image. When checked, Strokes Only will not fill any of the strokes from the vector image. Group will create a persistent group findable in the Design Manager. Scale factor will adjust the size of the placed image relative to original image dimensions.
label.translation: Choose the Target Layer to place the vector image. When checked, Strokes Only will not fill any of the strokes from the vector image. Group will create a persistent group findable in the Design Manager. Scale factor will adjust the size of the placed image relative to original image dimensions.

label.devLabel:
To move vector image as a whole, first select Group from Design Manager or draw a selection window around all curves on canvas.

If vector image does not import correctly, try simplifying image by reducing to one single color and removing background shapes.
label.translation:
To move vector image as a whole, first select Group from Design Manager or draw a selection window around all curves on canvas.

If vector image does not import correctly, try simplifying image by reducing to one single color and removing background shapes.

label.devLabel: Calls a specific symbol from a device.
label.translation: Calls a specific symbol from a device.

label.devLabel: Select a particular gate from a device already in use and place it in the schematic (example: a power symbol with Addlevel = Request).
label.translation: Select a particular gate from a device already in use and place it in the schematic (example: a power symbol with Addlevel = Request).

label.devLabel: Places a dot at intersecting nets.
label.translation: Places a dot at intersecting nets.

label.devLabel: A connection dot is placed at the intersection of nets to be connected. Junctions can be placed only on nets. If placed on the intersection of different nets, the user is given the option to connect the nets.
label.translation: A connection dot is placed at the intersection of nets to be connected. Junctions can be placed only on nets. If placed on the intersection of different nets, the user is given the option to connect the nets.

label.devLabel: Attaches text labels to buses and nets.
label.translation: Attaches text labels to buses and nets.

label.devLabel: Bus or net names can be placed on a schematic in any location. Click the bus or net with the mouse, and the relevant label attaches to the mouse cursor. It can be rotated (right click), and moved to a different location or layer. The second mouse click defines the location of the label.
label.translation: Bus or net names can be placed on a schematic in any location. Click the bus or net with the mouse, and the relevant label attaches to the mouse cursor. It can be rotated (right click), and moved to a different location or layer. The second mouse click defines the location of the label.

label.devLabel: Use the Schematic or PCB Display command to review and modify the layer display.
label.translation: Use the Schematic or PCB Display command to review and modify the layer display.

label.devLabel: Switch to the previous available layer.
label.translation: Switch to the previous available layer.

label.devLabel: Cycles through layers in reverse sequence order, skipping hidden or unavailable layers.
label.translation: Cycles through layers in reverse sequence order, skipping hidden or unavailable layers.

label.devLabel: Switch to the next available layer.
label.translation: Switch to the next available layer.

label.devLabel: Cycles through layers in sequence order, skipping hidden or unavailable layers.
label.translation: Cycles through layers in sequence order, skipping hidden or unavailable layers.

label.devLabel: Directly navigates to the Layer Stack page, making it easier to manage and adjust board layer composition.
label.translation: Directly navigates to the Layer Stack page, making it easier to manage and adjust board layer composition.

label.devLabel: The line begins at the first point specified and runs to the second. Additional points draw additional line segments. Two mouse clicks at the same position finish the line, and a new one can be started at the position of the next mouse click.
label.translation: The line begins at the first point specified and runs to the second. Additional points draw additional line segments. Two mouse clicks at the same position finish the line, and a new one can be started at the position of the next mouse click.

label.devLabel: Converts unrouted connections into routed wires (tracks).
label.translation: Converts unrouted connections into routed wires (tracks).

label.devLabel: This command activates the manual router, which converts airwires (unrouted connections) into real wires.
label.translation: This command activates the manual router, which converts airwires (unrouted connections) into real wires.

label.devLabel: Defines a mark on the drawing area.
label.translation: Defines a mark on the drawing area.

label.devLabel: The X and Y coordinates of the mouse cursor relative to that point are displayed above the canvas, with an R prefix, polar coordinates with P prefix. This command is useful when defining locations of components or cutouts. Enter MARK; to turn the mark off.
label.translation: The X and Y coordinates of the mouse cursor relative to that point are displayed above the canvas, with an R prefix, polar coordinates with P prefix. This command is useful when defining locations of components or cutouts. Enter MARK; to turn the mark off.

label.devLabel: Length tunes the length of a single trace or differential pair by adding a meander.
label.translation: Length tunes the length of a single trace or differential pair by adding a meander.

label.devLabel: Rotates symbols, objects, and text along their Y-axis and repositions them as a mirror of the original placement.
label.translation: Rotates symbols, objects, and text along their Y-axis and repositions them as a mirror of the original placement.

label.devLabel: Use Mirror to simplify the design while you avoid crossing nets.
label.translation: Use Mirror to simplify the design while you avoid crossing nets.

label.devLabel: Use this command to take the edge off a point where two wires join. The two wires must be on the the same layer, and must have the same width and wire style.
label.translation: Use this command to take the edge off a point where two wires join. The two wires must be on the the same layer, and must have the same width and wire style.

label.devLabel: Creates a module, and adds it to a new sheet.
label.translation: Creates a module, and adds it to a new sheet.

label.devLabel: Parts, pads, SMDs, pins and gates can also be selected by their name, which is especially useful if the object is outside the current window area. Note that when selecting a multi-gate part in a schematic by name, you will need to enter the full instance name, consisting of part and gate name.
label.translation: Parts, pads, SMDs, pins and gates can also be selected by their name, which is especially useful if the object is outside the current window area. Note that when selecting a multi-gate part in a schematic by name, you will need to enter the full instance name, consisting of part and gate name.

label.devLabel: Parts, elements, pads, SMDs, pins and gates can also be selected by their name, which is especially useful if the object is outside the currently shown window area. Other object types (e.g. nets, buses, signals) have to be clicked first.

label.devLabel: Draw nets and mark pins as No Connection (NC) on a schematic.
label.translation: Draw nets and mark pins as No Connection (NC) on a schematic.

label.devLabel: Draw individual connections (nets) on the Net layer of a schematic drawing. Click once to start a net and again to end a segment. Double-click the same point to finish the net. Or, mark pins as No Connection (NC).
label.translation: Draw individual connections (nets) on the Net layer of a schematic drawing. Click once to start a net and again to end a segment. Double-click the same point to finish the net. Or, mark pins as No Connection (NC).

label.devLabel: Breaks out nets from any pin of a component in the schematic.
label.translation: Breaks out nets from any pin of a component in the schematic.

label.devLabel: Automatically add wires with nets assigned to devices like microcontrollers and RAM, to save time and reduce net connectivity errors. You can use auto-increment and custom label formatting options.
label.translation: Automatically add wires with nets assigned to devices like microcontrollers and RAM, to save time and reduce net connectivity errors. You can use auto-increment and custom label formatting options.

label.devLabel: Displays custom net class and signal colors to make them easier to differentiate.
label.translation: Displays custom net class and signal colors to make them easier to differentiate.

label.devLabel: Press %1% to show or hide colors in the canvas.
label.translation: Press %1% to show or hide colors in the canvas.

label.devLabel: Customize appearance in the Inspector or Properties panel.
label.translation: Customize appearance in the Inspector or Properties panel.

label.devLabel: Makes multiple instances of the selected object(s) and places them in a linear or circular formation.
label.translation: Makes multiple instances of the selected object(s) and places them in a linear or circular formation.

label.devLabel: Select the objects to pattern. Specify the number of instances in the pattern, the X and Y spacing for rectangular, or angular spacing for circular patterns, and the start point for the pattern. Click OK .
label.translation: Select the objects to pattern. Specify the number of instances in the pattern, the X and Y spacing for rectangular, or angular spacing for circular patterns, and the start point for the pattern. Click OK .

label.devLabel: This command joins wire segments that lie in a straight line. The individual segments must be on the same layer and have the same width. This command is useful to reduce the number of objects in a drawing and to facilitate moving a complete track instead of individual segments.
label.translation: This command joins wire segments that lie in a straight line. The individual segments must be on the same layer and have the same width. This command is useful to reduce the number of objects in a drawing and to facilitate moving a complete track instead of individual segments.

label.devLabel: Polygon cutout on a routing layer will produce a void area in a polygon pour.
label.translation: Polygon cutout on a routing layer will produce a void area in a polygon pour.

label.translation: Polygons are used to create a copper sheet or layer for a signal, and must reside on a routing layer.

label.devLabel: Polygon is a simple non-signal solid polygon shape on any layer.
label.translation: Polygon is a simple non-signal solid polygon shape on any layer.

label.devLabel: Adds a package to the component.
label.translation: Adds a package to the component.

label.devLabel: This command attaches a package to the component to create a variant.
label.translation: This command attaches a package to the component to create a variant.

label.devLabel: Opens a dialog to search for packages from library.io.
label.translation: Opens a dialog to search for packages from library.io.

label.devLabel: This command attaches a package to the component to create a variant.
label.translation: This command attaches a package to the component to create a variant.

label.devLabel: Adds Plated Through-Hole (PTH) pads on a footprint.
label.translation: Adds Plated Through-Hole (PTH) pads on a footprint.

label.devLabel: PTH Pad dialog adjusts pad properties such as Rotate, PadShape, and Dimensions. Pads can be placed in the footprint area and are named sequentially based on their placement.
label.translation: PTH Pad dialog adjusts pad properties such as Rotate, PadShape, and Dimensions. Pads can be placed in the footprint area and are named sequentially based on their placement.

label.devLabel: Adds a series of PTH pads on a footprint.
label.translation: Adds a series of PTH pads on a footprint.

label.devLabel: Enter a Base Name, pick pad sides, select a shape, set pad numbers and start index. Add a border with >NAME and >VALUE labels and adjusts pad spacing in X and Y directions. Selecting OK places the pads.
label.translation: Enter a Base Name, pick pad sides, select a shape, set pad numbers and start index. Add a border with >NAME and >VALUE labels and adjusts pad spacing in X and Y directions. Selecting OK places the pads.

label.devLabel: Attaches a copy of the clipboard contents to the cursor, left click places the content at the cursor location on the specified layer.
label.translation: Attaches a copy of the clipboard contents to the cursor, left click places the content at the cursor location on the specified layer.

label.devLabel: Use Group, Copy, Cut, and Paste to add or subtract elements to or from your design, design block, or library component. Use right click to rotate the contents, in 90 degree increments, before placing it.
label.translation: Use Group, Copy, Cut, and Paste to add or subtract elements to or from your design, design block, or library component. Use right click to rotate the contents, in 90 degree increments, before placing it.

label.devLabel: Creates pins using data copied to the clipboard from an external source.
label.translation: Creates pins using data copied to the clipboard from an external source.

label.devLabel: Copy pin data from a datasheet, spreadsheet, or text file and then paste it into the current document.
label.translation: Copy pin data from a datasheet, spreadsheet, or text file and then paste it into the current document.

label.devLabel: Show or hide component origin markers on PCB.
label.translation: Show or hide component origin markers on PCB.

label.devLabel: Adds a Pin into an integrated circuit (IC) or chip symbol.
label.translation: Adds a Pin into an integrated circuit (IC) or chip symbol.

label.devLabel: Pins on symbols establish the connectivity. Each pin can have unique properties during placement.
label.translation: Pins on symbols establish the connectivity. Each pin can have unique properties during placement.

label.devLabel: Adds a series of Pins into an IC or chip symbol.
label.translation: Adds a series of Pins into an IC or chip symbol.

label.devLabel: Pin Arrays establish connectivity on symbols. Arrays can be personalized with a Base Name, selected placement sides, and distinct pin numbers and starting index. Including a rectangular outline and >NAME and >VALUE labels are optional.
label.translation: Pin Arrays establish connectivity on symbols. Arrays can be personalized with a Base Name, selected placement sides, and distinct pin numbers and starting index. Including a rectangular outline and >NAME and >VALUE labels are optional.

label.devLabel: Breaks out all or a selection of pins from the part by extending nets a short distance from the pins.
label.translation: Breaks out all or a selection of pins from the part by extending nets a short distance from the pins.

label.devLabel: New nets connected to pins are drawn and can be automatically named and labeled.
label.translation: New nets connected to pins are drawn and can be automatically named and labeled.

label.devLabel: Use this command to swap pins within the same symbol that have the same swaplevel (> 0). If a board is tied to a schematic via Back Annotation, two pads can only be swapped if the related pins are swappable.
label.translation: Use this command to swap pins within the same symbol that have the same swaplevel (> 0). If a board is tied to a schematic via Back Annotation, two pads can only be swapped if the related pins are swappable.

label.devLabel: Hide fill for all polygon pours.
label.translation: Hide fill for all polygon pours.

label.devLabel: Polygon pours are represented by an outline.
label.translation: Polygon pours are represented by an outline.

label.devLabel: Doing this repairs any damage to polygon pours as a result of moving components or cutouts.
label.translation: Doing this repairs any damage to polygon pours as a result of moving components or cutouts.

label.devLabel: Show fill for all polygon pours.
label.translation: Show fill for all polygon pours.

label.devLabel: Restore the fills for polygon pours after they were hidden.
label.translation: Restore the fills for polygon pours after they were hidden.

label.devLabel: Use this command to add ports to modules used in hierarchical schematics.
label.translation: Use this command to add ports to modules used in hierarchical schematics.

label.devLabel: Moves existing copper objects to make way for new copper objects while maintaining connectivity.
label.translation: Moves existing copper objects to make way for new copper objects while maintaining connectivity.

label.devLabel: In QuickRoute Airwire mode, you select individual airwires to be automatically routed, and they are instantly routed according to design rules.
label.translation: In QuickRoute Airwire mode, you select individual airwires to be automatically routed, and they are instantly routed according to design rules.

label.devLabel: Automatically routes multiple signals along a sketched path.
label.translation: Automatically routes multiple signals along a sketched path.

label.devLabel: Draw a selection line that intersects the signal objects you want to route concurrently (existing wires, pads, and vias). Right-click and draw the path for the selected signals. The signals are routed on the active layer with the fewest wire bends.
label.translation: Draw a selection line that intersects the signal objects you want to route concurrently (existing wires, pads, and vias). Right-click and draw the path for the selected signals. The signals are routed on the active layer with the fewest wire bends.

label.devLabel: Draw a selection line that intersects the signal objects that you want to route concurrently (existing wires, pads, and vias). Continue to draw additional selection lines to add more signal objects. Right-click to route all the airwires connected to the selected objects. The signals are routed on the active layer.
label.translation: Draw a selection line that intersects the signal objects that you want to route concurrently (existing wires, pads, and vias). Continue to draw additional selection lines to add more signal objects. Right-click to route all the airwires connected to the selected objects. The signals are routed on the active layer.

label.devLabel: Automatically routes a group of signal segments with the same name.
label.translation: Automatically routes a group of signal segments with the same name.

label.devLabel: Select any signal object (airwire, wire, pad, or via) and the command instantly routes all airwires that are members of that signal.
label.translation: Select any signal object (airwire, wire, pad, or via) and the command instantly routes all airwires that are members of that signal.

label.devLabel: Automatically smooths the wire sequence on a selected signal.
label.translation: Automatically smooths the wire sequence on a selected signal.

label.devLabel: QuickRoute Smooth reduces the number of wire bends and segments in the sequence.
label.translation: QuickRoute Smooth reduces the number of wire bends and segments in the sequence.

label.devLabel: Automatically tunes the length of multiple traces, differential pairs, or busses by adding meanders.
label.translation: Automatically tunes the length of multiple traces, differential pairs, or busses by adding meanders.

label.devLabel: Two points define two diagonally opposite corners of the rectangle.
label.translation: Two points define two diagonally opposite corners of the rectangle.

label.devLabel: Removes a custom 3D model override from an element or part.
label.translation: Removes a custom 3D model override from an element or part.

label.devLabel: The originally assigned 3D model reference is restored when you remove the override.
label.translation: The originally assigned 3D model reference is restored when you remove the override.

label.devLabel: Renumbers selected reference names based on preset options.
label.translation: Renumbers selected reference names based on preset options.

label.devLabel: The table will preview the proposed updates.
label.translation: The table will preview the proposed updates.

label.devLabel: Use this command to replace a schematic component with a different component (even from a different library). The old and new device must be compatible, in that their used gates and connected pins/pads must match, either by their names or their coordinates.
label.translation: Use this command to replace a schematic component with a different component (even from a different library). The old and new device must be compatible, in that their used gates and connected pins/pads must match, either by their names or their coordinates.

label.devLabel: Reverrts all routed wires and vias to airwires, and changes the display of polygons to outlines.
label.translation: Reverrts all routed wires and vias to airwires, and changes the display of polygons to outlines.

label.devLabel: This is usually done to prepare for re-routing all signals.
label.translation: This is usually done to prepare for re-routing all signals.

label.devLabel: Ripup Connected rips up 'direct' connections along a signal path.
label.translation: Ripup Connected rips up 'direct' connections along a signal path.

label.devLabel: Use this command to limit the scope of a ripup and make reworking sections easier.
label.translation: Use this command to limit the scope of a ripup and make reworking sections easier.

label.devLabel: The entire trace is reverted to airwires.
label.translation: The entire trace is reverted to airwires.

label.devLabel: Use to ripup all tracks, vias and polygons in a selected signal
label.translation: Use to ripup all tracks, vias and polygons in a selected signal

label.devLabel: Use this command to change the orientation of objects.
label.translation: Use this command to change the orientation of objects.

label.devLabel: Converts unrouted connections of a differential pair into routed wires (tracks).
label.translation: Converts unrouted connections of a differential pair into routed wires (tracks).

label.devLabel: This command activates the differential-pair manual router, and the differential pairs in the design are highlighted. To begin routing a differential pair, click one of the highlighted differential pair airwire or copper objects.
label.translation: This command activates the differential-pair manual router, and the differential pairs in the design are highlighted. To begin routing a differential pair, click one of the highlighted differential pair airwire or copper objects.

label.devLabel: Converts multiple unrouted connections into routed wires (tracks).
label.translation: Converts multiple unrouted connections into routed wires (tracks).

label.devLabel: This command activates the manual router, which converts multiple airwires (unrouted connections) into real wires.
label.translation: This command activates the manual router, which converts multiple airwires (unrouted connections) into real wires.

label.devLabel: Executes the commands in a script file.
label.translation: Executes the commands in a script file.

label.devLabel: Use this command to execute sequences of commands that are stored in a script file.
label.translation: Use this command to execute sequences of commands that are stored in a script file.

label.devLabel: Show or hide component origin markers in the schematic.
label.translation: Show or hide component origin markers in the schematic.

label.devLabel: Highlight complete signals and nets with the Show command. Select parts in Design Manager or enter names on the command line in format @ <partname> (example: @ FB2 FB4). If a bus is selected, all nets belonging to that bus are also highlighted.
label.translation: Highlight complete signals and nets with the Show command. Select parts in Design Manager or enter names on the command line in format @ <partname> (example: @ FB2 FB4). If a bus is selected, all nets belonging to that bus are also highlighted.

label.devLabel: Rips up short trace segments or longer segments to left or right.
label.translation: Rips up short trace segments or longer segments to left or right.

label.devLabel: Separate multiple board traces or schematic nets for rerouting. The width defines how much of the line is ripped up by the slice. Left or right options can be selected to rip up longer segments.
label.translation: Separate multiple board traces or schematic nets for rerouting. The width defines how much of the line is ripped up by the slice. Left or right options can be selected to rip up longer segments.

label.devLabel: Adds Surface Mount Device (SMD) pads on a footprint.
label.translation: Adds Surface Mount Device (SMD) pads on a footprint.

label.devLabel: SMD Pad dialog adjusts pad properties such as Angle, Size, and Roundness. Pads can be placed in the footprint area and are named sequentially based on their placement.
label.translation: SMD Pad dialog adjusts pad properties such as Angle, Size, and Roundness. Pads can be placed in the footprint area and are named sequentially based on their placement.

label.devLabel: Adds a series of SMD pads on a footprint.
label.translation: Adds a series of SMD pads on a footprint.

label.devLabel: Enter a Base Name, pick pad sides, select a shape, set pad numbers and start index. Add a border with >NAME and >VALUE labels and adjusts pad spacing in X and Y directions. Selecting OK places the pads.
label.translation: Enter a Base Name, pick pad sides, select a shape, set pad numbers and start index. Add a border with >NAME and >VALUE labels and adjusts pad spacing in X and Y directions. Selecting OK places the pads.

label.devLabel: Splits wires and polygon edges, adding new segments.
label.translation: Splits wires and polygon edges, adding new segments.

label.devLabel: Split a wire, segment, or polygon edge into two segments in order, for example, to introduce a bend. Split wires into parts that can be moved with the mouse during the Split command.
label.translation: Split a wire, segment, or polygon edge into two segments in order, for example, to introduce a bend. Split wires into parts that can be moved with the mouse during the Split command.

label.devLabel: Adds Via Stitching to a board.
label.translation: Adds Via Stitching to a board.

label.devLabel: Adjust settings like offset, spacing, pattern, and via sizes. Click OK to apply Via Stitching. Draw a Polygon to target a specific area, if not covering the entire board.
label.translation: Adjust settings like offset, spacing, pattern, and via sizes. Click OK to apply Via Stitching. Draw a Polygon to target a specific area, if not covering the entire board.

label.devLabel: This command will toggle a panel that can be used to place components onto a schematic, or footprints onto a board.
label.translation: This command will toggle a panel that can be used to place components onto a schematic, or footprints onto a board.

label.devLabel: Moves vias to accommodate new copper objects.
label.translation: Moves vias to accommodate new copper objects.

label.devLabel: Switches betwen displaying all board layers and only the active layer.
label.translation: Switches betwen displaying all board layers and only the active layer.

label.devLabel: Useful when routing a dense design.
label.translation: Useful when routing a dense design.

label.devLabel: Show or hide component origin markers on the top layer.
label.translation: Show or hide component origin markers on the top layer.

label.devLabel: Converts routed wires and vias into unrouted signals, and changes polygons to outlines.
label.translation: Converts routed wires and vias into unrouted signals, and changes polygons to outlines.

label.devLabel: Choose an unroute method to control which wires are affected.
label.translation: Choose an unroute method to control which wires are affected.

label.devLabel: Converts all wire segments and vias to unrouted signals.
label.translation: Converts all wire segments and vias to unrouted signals.

label.devLabel: Converts all stubs and incomplete segments to unrouted signals.
label.translation: Converts all stubs and incomplete segments to unrouted signals.

label.devLabel: Assign values to circuit elements, such as '1k' for a resistor.
label.translation: Assign values to circuit elements, such as '1k' for a resistor.

label.devLabel: When the Via command is active, a via symbol is attached to the cursor. Click to place a via at the current position.
label.translation: When the Via command is active, a via symbol is attached to the cursor. Click to place a via at the current position.

label.devLabel: Manages interactions between copper objects, including traced routes and vias, based on preferred clearance in Design Rules.
label.translation: Manages interactions between copper objects, including traced routes and vias, based on preferred clearance in Design Rules.

label.devLabel: Moves new copper objects around existing copper objects and components while following Design Rules.
label.translation: Moves new copper objects around existing copper objects and components while following Design Rules.

label.devLabel: Syncs changes from 2D PCB to 3D PCB. If no 3D PCB is linked, creates a new 3D PCB document. Provides preferences for object visibility and fidelity in the 3D PCB document.
label.translation: Syncs changes from 2D PCB to 3D PCB. If no 3D PCB is linked, creates a new 3D PCB document. Provides preferences for object visibility and fidelity in the 3D PCB document.

label.devLabel: Select the 2D PCB objects you want in the 3D PCB. Components without 3D models are identified and represented by rectangular shapes if you include them.
label.translation: Select the 2D PCB objects you want in the 3D PCB. Components without 3D models are identified and represented by rectangular shapes if you include them.

label.devLabel: Creates a 2D PCB document for the active Electronic design.
label.translation: Creates a 2D PCB document for the active Electronic design.

label.devLabel: Schematic and 2D PCB documents are automatically synchronized. For design efficiency, create the schematic first then the PCB. Useful for creating 2D PCB designs that do not require a schematic.
label.translation: Schematic and 2D PCB documents are automatically synchronized. For design efficiency, create the schematic first then the PCB. Useful for creating 2D PCB designs that do not require a schematic.

label.devLabel: Create the PCB, the components in the schematic are placed at the lower left. Position them according to your design needs.
label.translation: Create the PCB, the components in the schematic are placed at the lower left. Position them according to your design needs.

label.devLabel: Creates an empty schematic document for the active Electronic design.
label.translation: Creates an empty schematic document for the active Electronic design.

label.devLabel: Only one schematic is used for each design. A schematic can have as many sheets as are needed, up to 999, for designing the board diagram.
label.translation: Only one schematic is used for each design. A schematic can have as many sheets as are needed, up to 999, for designing the board diagram.

label.devLabel: This is the starting point of the new design. Create the schematic, then the PCB layout of the components in the schematic.
label.translation: This is the starting point of the new design. Create the schematic, then the PCB layout of the components in the schematic.

label.devLabel: Syncs changes from 3D PCB to 2D PCB. If no 2D PCB is linked to 3D PCB, creates a new 2D PCB document.
label.translation: Syncs changes from 3D PCB to 2D PCB. If no 2D PCB is linked to 3D PCB, creates a new 2D PCB document.

label.devLabel: Once you link a 2D PCB, you can remove the link only in 2D PCB.
label.translation: Once you link a 2D PCB, you can remove the link only in 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Adds a non-plated through hole to the 3D PCB. When synced to 2D PCB, generates a symbol on the Holes layer and a circle with the diameter of the hole on the Board Outline Layer.
label.translation: Adds a non-plated through hole to the 3D PCB. When synced to 2D PCB, generates a symbol on the Holes layer and a circle with the diameter of the hole on the Board Outline Layer.

label.devLabel: Select a hole type, select a face or sketch point to place the hole, and specify the hole diameter. For At Point type, select references for precise hole positioning.
label.translation: Select a hole type, select a face or sketch point to place the hole, and specify the hole diameter. For At Point type, select references for precise hole positioning.

label.devLabel: Links an existing PCB document to this 3D PCB. Only one 2D PCB can be linked at a time.
label.translation: Links an existing PCB document to this 3D PCB. Only one 2D PCB can be linked at a time.

label.devLabel: To link a different 2D PCB to this 3D PCB, remove the link from the 2D PCB.
label.translation: To link a different 2D PCB to this 3D PCB, remove the link from the 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Links an existing PCB document to the active Electronic design.
label.translation: Links an existing PCB document to the active Electronic design.

label.translation: Switches to a 2D layout of the physical printed circuit board that defines component placement and routing. If no 2D PCB exists, creates 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Switches to a logical representation of the electronic circuit that defines signals and connections.
